derivation: from H8105 (שֶׁמֶר) in its original sense; watchful;
def: Shimri, the name of four Israelites

occurrences.text: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:
